lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Cloud Nine Logistics! Every delivery in the realm routes through this sky-hub. Including, nine years ago, my birthday present.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Is that why we're here?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: We're here to save the kingdom's supply lines. But if we HAPPEN to find a small box addressed to Pip... we take it.

lines.speaker: Sorting Sphinx
lines.text: ANSWER MY RIDDLE OR BE MISROUTED: What has four digits, defines your fate, and nobody remembers theirs?

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: A zip code.

lines.speaker: Sorting Sphinx
lines.text: CORRECT. UNFORTUNATELY I AM STILL CONTRACTUALLY REQUIRED TO FIGHT YOU.
The Dead Letter Office. Paper slips swirl like snow. Something vast breathes beneath them.

lines.speaker: FINAL NOTICE
lines.text: WE ATTEMPTED DELIVERY. YOU. WERE. HOME.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: I heard the knock! I ran to the door in eight seconds!

lines.speaker: FINAL NOTICE
lines.text: EIGHT SECONDS IS AN ETERNITY. PREPARE FOR REDELIVERY.

lines.speaker: FINAL NOTICE
lines.text: Package... released... all packages... released...
Nine years of parcels rain gently from the sky. Somewhere, everyone's missing left glove comes home.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: MY BIRTHDAY PRESENT! It's... a smaller box. Addressed to me. From me. "Do not open until the finale." PIP, YOU ABSOLUTE MYSTERY.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Hero! The cargo manifest! Line 88,412: "One (1) small box. Sender: Pip. Recipient: Pip. Note: do not open until the finale."

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: You mailed yourself a box and forgot?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: I NEVER forget. I file. Somewhere in my past is a Pip with a PLAN, and I intend to honor her paperwork.
The clouds ahead wear a tiny badge: ROUTE MANAGER.

lines.speaker: Thunderhead
lines.text: YOU ARE OFF ROUTE. EVERYTHING IS OFF ROUTE. I HAVE A QUOTA OF STORMS AND YOU ARE WEATHER NOW.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: We're pedestrians.

lines.speaker: Thunderhead
lines.text: PEDESTRIANS ARE SLOW PACKAGES.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Did you see Dave back there?! "Regional Slime Manager, LOGISTICS DIVISION." He transferred! He got a lateral move out of losing to us!

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Everyone we beat gets promoted. I'm starting to feel used.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Focus. The Dead Letter Office is ahead — and my box is INSIDE.
